test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Aditya and Bhaskar take a contract to complete a work for ₹15,000. Aditya alone can do it in 15 days, while Bhaskar alone can do it in 18 days. With the help of Chandra, they complete it in 6 days. Find the share of Chandra.
solution:
**Given:**

Aditya and Bhaskar complete a work in Rs15,000 

Aditya alone completes work in 15 days 

Bhaskar alone completes work in 18 days 

With the help of Chandra work is done in 6 days 

**Formula used:**

Efficiency
 = Total work /No. of days 

C
